reference_resolution.rule: Inherited source/evidence references resolve to the unchanged original staging tree. Current artifact and QA references below are absolute. Original task/batch labels in report headers identify the initial-review lineage, not a second acceptance assignment.

acceptance_scope: Focused independent acceptance of the existing scientific report; inherited scientific coverage and limitations are not expanded to new experiments or a fresh full review.
